title: 第16章 虚穹九改第17章 虚穹十改
content_zh:
森林里，泰尔聚集了所有的穹族人。
“我有一个问题要问你们。那些虚族人强大且仇视我们，我敢肯定他们会找到方法走出城市，到那时就是我们流亡的时候，到那时不再是食物短缺的问题，而是被猎杀。你们也看到那城市里有能供我们生存的食物，而我们也不想面对死亡，所以我们不再逃避，而是要与那些虚族人战斗。如果你们有人不想参加，现在就可以回去山谷躲避，我不会笑话你们，因为我也曾这样想过。”泰尔站在人群中央，看着四周的穹族人。那些穹族人相互看了看，年轻的与强壮的穹族人直接站出来，向泰尔表达自己的决心。
“我们不会逃走的，我们选择战斗。”泰格第一个高声喊道。
“对，我们躲得太辛苦了！”
“是的，我们是战士！”
“哦！”有人带头之下，其他人血脉里名为战士的灵魂觉醒了，这些穹族人没有一个要走。
“很好，那么我们将兵分两路前往城市，一路直接前往广场方向吸引那些虚族人，另一队由我们的外族朋友带领，从城市旁的山崖潜入破坏他们的防御系统。”
“哦！”
虚族人的议会所。
“据影像看到的分析，那些穹族人分成了两伙人。”
“他们一定有阴谋。”
“实验结果出来了，对得病的一批族人进行蚀能脉冲后情况好转，已经确定再次引发灭生岩化可以恢复族人。”
“重新整理我们发动灭生岩化的材料，填充魔能。”那些虚族人立刻开始行动起来。
城市边缘的山崖对于虚族人来说可能是天堑，但是强化身体后的穹族人完全不怕，他们身手矫健，准备攀登这直达天际的山崖。
“走了这四个多小时，现在还要爬这座山，要了我的命了。”跟着这些好像不怕累的穹族人，作家可是尝尽了苦头。
经作家发现，穹族人身体之中充满了力量，在作家的世界里将这力量称为魔能，魔能是使用魔法的基础，穹族人天生就能用它强化身体。这与虚族人正好相反，作家看到的虚族人他们身体无法储存魔能，但是他们用了尖端科学与魔能相结合的方法，利用金属法衣吸收魔能，转而供给里面的虚族人使用，而且他们不能离开城市也是因为城市使用了金属衣的材料与技术，储存了庞大的魔能，那些虚族人利用金属衣再操纵魔能让城市运作，离开了城市就相当于切断了魔能供给，他们孱弱的身体无法离开金属衣生存。
穹族人们开始攀爬这座不可能翻越的山崖，时不时掉落的山石常常引起骚乱，但是他们还是向上一往无前。
“呜！”当一名穹族人从山崖摔下后，剩下的穹族人没有回身去看那掉下去的族人，只有向上翻过这座山的精神存在。当穹族人决定某一件事之后，他们就会这样坚持到底。只是苦了作家，就算有两名穹族人帮着他，也是攀爬得很吃力。
这时的虚族人也在忙碌中。
“发动灭生岩化的程序已经就绪。”一名虚族人道。

“警告，那些穹族人有大规模行动。”突然另一名虚族人回报。
“调动所有监控力量去广场那边。”
城市入口广场那边，穹族人聚集在那里，早就准备好了进攻的准备，手里的武器都是原始的长矛与盾牌、弓箭，还有飞石索这种更加古老的东西，但是差别在于这些武器都被赋予了魔能石（一种蕴含魔能的矿石）在里面，使武器得到了强化，更不用说飞石索上绑着的就是一块活跃的魔能石。这些穹族人一定在某处发现了魔能石矿。
穹族人能在外界生存，而虚族人只能固守一地。在广场方向穹族人的聚集吸引了虚族人的大部分注意。
“东边山崖方向有压力警报。”一名虚族人报告。
“分出人手前往，其他人准备启动灭生岩化。”
终于从山崖挺过来的作家他们进入了城市里，那座落在中央的高大信号塔，所有魔能都向那里流动，它一定就是控制魔能的中枢。被正面穹族人吸引的虚族人放在这边的人手果然不足，作家吩咐跟来的穹族人分成两队，一队去更下面的魔能储存区进行破坏，自己则带几个人直接前往控制室。他们小心的潜入信号塔，里面的路上都没有看到太多的虚族人。
推开里面的门，一台台精密的机器正在运转，魔能在这里异常庞大。找到控制室，作家上前手中不停改写控制室里的程序。
“停止！”虚族人那标准的冰冷声调传出，数名虚族人已经将他们这些人包围，作家转身看到不知道什么时候自己的那些同伴全部被无声无息的击倒在地，只有他一个站在这里。
作家假装举起手来，见对方放松快一步按了下最后的确认键，接着就是一连串的火花让整个信号塔的动作停了下来。与此同时，闪动着光芒的法杖也敲在了他的身体上，让他瞬间失去了知觉。
再次悠悠转醒，那些虚族人竟然没有杀死自己，而是将他带到了议会室里。双手顿时传来冰冷感，金属的手铐将他固定在了墙上。
“你们的小动作都将是无用的，现在我们将重启灭生岩化程序再次净化这个世界。”一名虚族人站在作家面前说道。
“为什么你们一定要消灭穹族人？他们根本没有发起战争的想法，一个世界里容不下两个种族吗？”被铐在墙上的作家问向虚族人。
“这个世界只允许一个种族存在，我们虚族将做为唯一的种族统治这个世界，穹族人唯一的用处就是被我们消灭。”虚族人的说话依然没有感情。
“准备启动灭生岩化。”
“等一下！我有件事要告诉你们！我有件东西可以为你们所用，只要你们放过穹族人，我就可以将我的法师塔给你们。”作家见虚族人要有所动作，马上说道。
“法师塔？那是什么?”
“那是存在于时空夹缝里的神奇，用它你们可以穿梭于其他世界，不再居住在这蚀能腐化的世界！”
“你的说法根本无法让人相信。”虚族人摇头道。
content_en:
In the forest, Tyr gathered all the Qiong people.
"I have a question to ask you. Those Void people are powerful and hate us. I'm sure they will find a way to get out of the city. At that time, we will be in exile. At that time, it will no longer be a problem of food shortage, but being hunted. You also see that there is food in the city that can sustain us. , and we don’t want to face death, so we no longer want to escape, but will fight with those Void people. If any of you don’t want to participate, you can go back to the valley to hide now. I won’t laugh at you, because I have thought so too.” Taier stood in the middle of the crowd and looked at the Qiong people. The Qiong tribesmen looked at each other, and the young and strong Qiong tribesmen stood up directly to express their determination to Tyr.
"We will not run away, we choose to fight." Tiger was the first to shout loudly.
"Yes, we hid too hard!"
"Yes, we are warriors!"
"Oh!" Under someone's leadership, the souls called warriors in other people's bloodlines awakened, and none of these Qiong tribe members wanted to leave.
"Very good, then we will divide our troops into two groups to head to the city. One group will go directly to the square to attract those Void people. The other group will be led by our foreign friends and sneak into the cliff next to the city to destroy their defense system."
"Oh!"
The meeting place of the Xu people.
"According to the analysis of the video, the Qiong people are divided into two groups."
"They must have a conspiracy."
"The results of the experiment are out. The condition of a group of sick tribesmen improved after being subjected to energy erosion pulses. It has been determined that the tribesmen can be restored by triggering lithification again."
"Reorganize the materials we used to activate the lithification of life and fill them with magic energy." The Void people immediately started to take action.
The cliff on the edge of the city may be a natural chasm for the Xu people, but the Qiong people who have strengthened their bodies are not afraid at all. They are strong and ready to climb this cliff that reaches the sky.
"I've been walking for more than four hours, and now I have to climb this mountain. It's going to kill me." Following these Qiong people who seem not to be afraid of getting tired, the writer has suffered a lot.
The writer discovered that the bodies of the Qiong tribe are full of power. In the writer's world, this power is called magic energy. Magic energy is the basis for the use of magic. The Qiong tribe people are born with the ability to use it to strengthen their bodies. This is exactly the opposite of the Void people. The writer saw that the Void people cannot store magic energy in their bodies, but they use a method that combines cutting-edge science and magic energy. They use metal robes to absorb magic energy and supply it to the Void people inside. Moreover, they cannot leave the city because the city uses the materials and technology of the metal clothes to store huge amounts of magic energy.
The people of the Qiong tribe began to climb this impossible cliff. The rocks that fell from time to time often caused commotion, but they still kept moving forward.
"Woo!" When a Qiong tribe member fell from the cliff, the remaining Qiong tribe members did not turn around to look at the fallen tribesman, only the spirit of climbing up the mountain existed. When the Qiong people decide on something, they will stick to it until the end. It's just a pity for the writer that even with two Qiong tribe members helping him, it is still very difficult to climb.
At this time, the Xu clan people were also busy.
"The procedure for initiating the lithification of life and death is ready." A Void tribe member said.
"Warning, those Qiong tribe members are taking large-scale actions." Suddenly another Void tribe member reported.
"Mobilize all surveillance forces to the square."
Over at the entrance square of the city, the Qiong people gathered there, already prepared for an attack. The weapons in their hands were primitive spears, shields, bows and arrows, as well as more ancient things like flying stone ropes, but the difference was that these weapons were all endowed with magic stones (A kind of ore containing magic energy) is inside, which strengthens the weapon, not to mention that there is an active magic stone tied to the flying stone rope. These Qiong people must have discovered a mana stone mine somewhere.
The Qiong people can survive in the outside world, but the Xu people can only stick to one place. The gathering of Qiong people in the direction of the square attracted most of the attention of the Xu people.
"There is a pressure warning in the direction of the eastern cliff." A Xu clan member reported.
"Split your hands and go there, the others are going to start the lithification of life and death."
The writers who finally survived from the cliff entered the city. The tall signal tower in the center, where all the magic energy flows, must be the center for controlling magic energy. The Xu clan people who were attracted by the Qiong clan people in front of them really didn't have enough manpower here. The writer ordered the Qiong clan people who came to divide into two teams. One team went to the magic energy storage area below to destroy it, while he took a few people directly to the control room. They carefully sneaked into the signal tower and didn't see too many Void people on the road inside.
Pushing open the door inside, a series of sophisticated machines are running, and the magic energy here is extremely huge. After finding the control room, the writer stepped forward and kept rewriting the program in the control room.
"Stop!" The standard cold tone of the Void people came out, and several Void people had already surrounded them. The writer turned around and saw that all his companions were knocked to the ground silently at some point, and he was the only one standing here.
The writer pretended to raise his hand. Seeing that the other party relaxed, he quickly pressed the final confirmation button. Then a series of sparks caused the entire signal tower to stop. At the same time, the flashing staff also hit his body, causing him to lose consciousness instantly.
When he woke up again, the Xu clan people did not kill him, but brought him to the council room. His hands suddenly felt cold, and the metal handcuffs fixed him to the wall.
"Your little actions will be useless. Now we will restart the lithification process to purify the world again." A Void tribe member stood in front of the writer and said.
"Why do you have to eliminate the Qiong tribe? They have no idea of ​​starting a war. Can't there be room for two races in the same world?" The writer who was handcuffed to the wall asked the Xu tribe.
"Only one race is allowed to exist in this world. We, the Void tribe, will rule this world as the only race. The only use of the Qiong tribe is to be eliminated by us." The words of the Void tribe are still emotionless.
"Prepare to initiate extinct lithification."
"Wait a minute! I have something to tell you! I have something that can be used by you. As long as you let go of the Qiong tribe, I can give you my mage tower." The writer said immediately when he saw that the Void tribe wanted to take action.
"Mage Tower? What is that?"
"That is the magic that exists in the gap between time and space. With it, you can travel to other worlds and no longer live in this corrosive world!"
"Your statement is simply unbelievable." The Xu clan member shook his head.
